title: WPSS/745/2012 of SMT SANGEETA CHAUHAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS Nos. 745 of 2012, 1049 of 2010, 1053 of 2010 & 744 of 2012
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. D.S. Mehta, Advocate, holding
brief of Mr. N.S. Negi, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. B.S. Parihar, Standing Counsel for
the State.
Since common question of law and
facts are involved in all these petitions,
therefore, the same are being taken up
together and decided by this common
judgment. In order to maintain clarity, the
facts of WPSS No. 1049 of 2010 are taken
into consideration.
The petitioner participated in the
selection process for the post of Assistant
Teacher (L.T. Grade). There are two streams
in the respondent-Department i.e. General
and Women. Since the petitioner has
secured lesser quality marks, she was to be
allotted General stream. However,
respondent-Department in its own wisdom
has allocated the petitioner to the Women
stream. The petitioner started discharging
her duties of Assistant Teacher (L.T. Grade)
in Women stream. She was assigned the
seniority in the same stream. She was
promoted to the post of Lecturer (Home
Science) on 06.08.2010. She joined her
duties on 10.08.2010. An option was sought
from the petitioner on 13.08.2010, after she
was promoted and permitted to join her
duties on 10.08.2010. The petitioner filed a
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 796 of 2010, which
was decided on 06.09.2010. Thereafter, the
petitioner made a representation on
11.09.2010, which was rejected on
30.10.2010 (Annexure No.13).
The case of the respondent/State,
precisely, is that on the basis of merit drawn
at the time of selection, the petitioner
should have been assigned the General
stream/wing/cadre. However, by mistake,

the petitioner was assigned Women
stream/wing/cadre. The petitioner has
neither misrepresented nor misstated the
facts. She has not concealed any facts at the
time when she was allocated Women cadre
in pursuant to the appointment on
11.06.2003. She has continuously without
interruption discharged the duties in the
Women stream. She was promoted as per
the seniority list on 06.08.2010.
The respondent as noticed hereinabove
has sought petitionerís option only on
13.08.2010 after permitting her to discharge
the duties on Women stream w.e.f.
11.06.2003.
The petitioner on the basis of the
allocation made to Women stream has
altered her position. She remained in this
cadre for seven long years. The respondents
are estopped from changing her cadre from
Women to General by seeking her option on
13.08.2010.
The representation has been rejected
by the Competent Authority on 25.10.2010
by making an observation that by mistake,
the petitioner was allocated the Women
cadre though she was supposed to be in
General cadre. The petitioner has acquired
certain rights by working in Women cadre
w.e.f. 11.06.2003 on the basis of which, she
was promoted on 06.10.2010. The action of
the respondent changing the cadre of the
petitioner to her detriment after seven years
is illegal and arbitrary.
The petitioner has referred to an
advertisement in her representation with
regard to allocation. The same has also been
overlooked.
Accordingly, the writ petitions are
allowed. Impugned annexures under
challenge are quashed and set aside.
Respondents are directed to permit the

petitioners to discharge the duties of
Lecturer in their respective subjects.
 (Rajiv Sharma, J.)
 10.04.2018
Jitendra
